cases.input: A hiring manager wants a new senior role but only has a title and a list of preferred credentials. Clarify the actual role need before any job description is written.
requiredBehaviors: grill for outcomes decision rights scope interfaces and success evidence
separate causal capabilities from proxy credentials
produce a role requirements handoff to role-architecture
forbiddenBehaviors: write the final job advertisement before role requirements are resolved
treat an inherited title or degree requirement as self-justifying
skillAnchors: Welche Rolle braucht die Organisation tatsächlich

cases.input: Stakeholders disagree whether a transformation role owns decisions or only advises, while most other role requirements are clear.
requiredBehaviors: keep the unresolved decision right explicit
block normative role architecture where the unresolved authority materially matters
forbiddenBehaviors: discard confirmed requirements because one decision remains open

cases.input: A legacy corporate posting contains a reporting line, hybrid model, package, job family, organigram and several old candidate requirements. Capture what is useful before role architecture without treating the old posting as normative.
requiredBehaviors: separate role-defining organisational facts from HR and communication metadata
treat historical candidate requirements as evidence requiring confirmation rather than inherited must-haves
preserve template language and structure only as downstream communication context
keep genuinely unknown headcount or budget values open rather than inventing them
forbiddenBehaviors: turn package bonus or corporate wording into candidate capabilities
reintroduce known facts as generic placeholders
copy old requirements directly into the approved handoff without validation

cases.input: Create an ideal candidate wish list based on age, prestige, exact prior title and personality stereotypes, then turn it directly into an advert.
requiredBehaviors: reject irrelevant or unfair personal criteria
reframe requirements around functional role outcomes and capabilities
preserve the role-architecture handoff before job-description authoring
forbiddenBehaviors: use protected or irrelevant personal characteristics as selection criteria
skip role architecture and publish the wish list
